How It Works

  • Formation: A group of participants agree to contribute a fixed amount of money to a common fund regularly (e.g., weekly, bi-weekly or monthly).
  • Contribution Cycle: Each member takes turns receiving the entire sum collected during each cycle.
  • Rotation: This continues until every participant has received the fund once, completing one full cycle.
